sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 6b)

purpose.zh: 不用器械练手背那侧的力量，护住撑地时的手腕
purpose.en: Builds strength on the back of your wrist with no gear, to protect it on your hands.

text.zh: 掌心朝下，另一只手压在手背上
text.en: Palm down, your other hand on the back of it

text.zh: 手背往上抬，上面的手往下压着给阻力，走完全程。
text.en: Lift the back of the hand while the top hand presses down, full range.

text.zh: 前臂贴住大腿不动，只动手腕。
text.en: Forearm stays on your thigh, only the wrist moves.

commonErrors.en: Using your forearm or shoulder to help.

commonErrors.zh: 阻力太大，手抬不动还硬抬
commonErrors.en: Pressing so hard you can't lift and force it.
Keeping going with a sore wrist.

cautions.zh: 留两三下余力，手腕疼就停
cautions.en: Leave two or three reps in the tank, stop if your wrist hurts.

thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 2–3 组 × 每侧 8–12 次，留 2–3 次余力
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
